statement: Refitting the Brasileirão goal model every round (about 10 matches) instead of every 100 matches lowers the 1X2 RPS against the serving model
metric: paired 1X2 RPS difference (round refit minus 100-match refit), cluster bootstrap 95% CI
design: walk-forward with decision cutoff 1h before kickoff; one evaluation at the end; no interim reads
author: cain (draft for the owner)
